4477-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4477-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

720-1806-2034-7192.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-7192.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

5870-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5870-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.

719-1168-3510-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-1168-3510-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2317-4050-5478-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

225-2292-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2292-2577-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

628-4247-7197.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1308-5478-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-5478-6753-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

4050-5070-7498-7541.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 5 life.
Grave Researcher is prepared.
4050-5070-7498-7541.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve Biblioplex Tromekeeper's trigger, preparing Grave Researcher.
Resolve Angelic Chorus's trigger, gaining 4 life.
Repeat.

275-5078-6289.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1362-1479-7889.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, it, Dancing from Dark to Dawn, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, it and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3249-5173-5334-6797.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

430-1308-2743-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-1308-2743-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Anointed Procession.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

3259-7397.easyPrerequisites: You've cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 1 or greater this turn.
3259-7397.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7397.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rootha triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

546-4613-5900-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 5 life this turn.
546-4613-5900-7237.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Voracious Wurm. Voracious Wurm enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Voracious Wurm using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

791-3693-4522-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
791-3693-4522-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4017-4094-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4017-4094-5086-5183.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.

2366-5175-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5175-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

270-1456-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4927-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1939-2034-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Luminous Phantom triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
1939-2034-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5555-6331-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5555-6331-6797.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2615-6562-6791.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-6562-6791.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

730-1479-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

678-2921-4826-6644.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1110-1916-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Changeling Titan.
1110-1916-3362.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {3}{R}.
When Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, it and Terror of the Peaks trigger.
Resolve the Changeling Titan trigger, exiling Bladewing until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage to Changeling Titan equal to Changeling Titan's power.
Changeling Titan dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
When Changeling Titan dies, it triggers, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Terror of the Peaks trigger.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Bladewing's power to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning Changeling Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2511-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2511-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4647-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

38-2757-3705-5465.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Mountain.
38-2757-3705-5465.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Squee, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5641.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Basking Broodscale has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-3143-5641.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

2103-2660-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve the first Phyrexian Devourer ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power is at least seven, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from your library.
Repeat from step 6.

957-2556-2963.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat during each even-numbered extra turn.

259-2103-4428.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

1300-3525-4050-4459.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other Shrines.
1300-3525-4050-4459.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Go-Shintai triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Go-Shintai's ability.
Resolve the copy of Go-Shintai's ability, paying {1} to create at least four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirit tokens, adding {1}{U}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.

2882-4675-4694-4966.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4694-4966.description:
Cast Chrome Mox by paying {0}.
Chrome Mox enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Chrome Mox from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

65-717-808-2628-5181.description:
Activate Canyon Slough's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Canyon Slough, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Canyon Slough trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Canyon Slough from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
